Palo Alto Networks Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Financial Results
Palo Alto Networks (NASDAQ: PANW) announced today financial results.
Financial Highlights • Total revenue for the fiscal first quarter 2027 grew 39% year over year to $3.44 billion.
